integrity: Derivation is analytic. Exhaustive finite graph enumeration is a consistency check and is not presented as a proof for all orders. No independent validation or authorship attribution is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Independent arcs, loopless graph, n>=2 and 0<p<1 only; no claim of chi-square null law; implicit historical coverage by Bernoulli row/column-frequency literature cannot be excluded.
title: A three-null-direction covariance geometry for directed random-graph degree histograms
